name: Bell Laboratories silicon solar cell
description: Bell Laboratories researchers developed a silicon p-n junction solar cell converting light into electrical power, demonstrated in 1954.

date.label: April 1954
date.basis: APS retrospective dates demonstration to April 1954; exact day and event sequence need contemporary corroboration.

events.statement: Bell Laboratories demonstrated a silicon photovoltaic solar battery in April 1954, developed by Daryl Chapin, Calvin Fuller and Gerald Pearson.
events.caveats: APS dates the public announcement to April 25; the Computer History Museum dates the announcement to April 26. The relationship between these accounts and the exact demonstration date needs contemporary corroboration; earlier photovoltaic devices existed.
